name: Mango Sherbet Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Mango Sherbet is an indica cross between Mango Trees, Mango Kush, and Sherbert. It grows fluffy, resinous buds that produce a fruity aroma of mango and sherbet. Mango Sherbet keeps you motivated, making it an ideal strain for an afternoon adventure or creative escapes.
